purpose: Patch-level audit for scraped-data/planner-expansions.json. This file records only corrections, confidence changes, and genuinely missing rows; it is not a second canonical planner dataset.

policy.freshness_rule: A PvME page carrying the site-wide March 2 2026 Combat Modernization warning must not be labelled pvme_current unless the specific claim has been independently revalidated after that warning.

source_findings.finding: The page currently states that, following the March 2 2026 Combat Modernization, the vast majority of PvME content is outdated while the site is rebuilt.
source_findings.impact: Rows sourced only from this page may remain as method-discovery candidates, but confidence values such as pvme_current overstate freshness. Do not use them for current XP rates, combat performance, or best-method ranking without a newer independent source.

confidence_patches.reason: Keep the useful method candidates, but stop presenting an explicitly stale PvME page as current validation.
